label: The Art of Memory
summary: A treatise on the classical art of memory, fixing recollection through imagined spatial arrangement.

claims.statement: Entered as no. 15 in the reconstructed catalogue of Leonardo's books, under Language, Rhetoric and Grammar. Leonardo's wording as rendered there: "memory by places".
check_in: Leonardo's autograph book lists: Codex Trivulzianus f. 2r; Codex Atlanticus f. 559r; Madrid Codex II ff. 2v to 3r (which list names this title to be established)

claims.statement: Identified in the reconstruction as Ars memoriae. The identification of a title in Leonardo's lists with a specific work and edition is an interpretation.
